executive_bullets_en: Last session: MU -7.02%, ALAB -5.23%, QBTS -6.42% as 30y yields hit highest since 2007 on oil spike.
Best opportunity: CRWD (ACCUMULATION) Stage2=7/RS=100, optimistic ahead of Aug 27 earnings.
Biggest risk: Hormuz escalation lifting oil while 30y yields pressure growth names; VIX at 15.84 still calm.

market_mood.explanation_en: The regime score of 87.7 sits in RISK_ON territory, like a green traffic light with flickering yellow warnings. High distribution days on SPY and QQQ plus rising yields mean buying today requires extra caution even though the overall reading stays favorable.

big_picture.summary_en: Reports indicate escalating Strait of Hormuz tensions are lifting oil prices while US 30-year yields reached their highest level since 2007 on inflation and war fears. These twin pressures are transmitting directly into risk assets with asymmetric effects on energy and growth names.
big_picture.summary_ko: 보도에 따르면 호르무즈 해협 긴장이 고조되며 유가가 상승하고, 인플레이션과 전쟁 우려로 미국 30년물 국채 금리가 2007년 이후 최고치를 기록했습니다. 이 두 압력은 에너지와 성장주에 비대칭적으로 영향을 미치며 리스크 자산에 직접 전파되고 있습니다.
big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 15.84, a calm reading that suggests investors are not yet pricing in panic despite the geopolitical headlines.

big_picture.rates_note_en: The 10-year yield at 4.71% is acting as a headwind for growth stocks by raising discount rates and pressuring valuations.
